tldr: North Node in libra: growth through relationship skill, fairness, reciprocity, and chosen partnership.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop relationship skill, fairness, reciprocity, and chosen partnership. The South Node in aries shows the familiar route: reactivity, isolation, unilateral action, and mistaking conflict for freedom. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to let connection refine your choices.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices relationship skill, fairness, reciprocity, and chosen partnership in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in aries can pull the person back into reactivity, isolation, unilateral action, and mistaking conflict for freedom.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
